ultrawide_sensor: 5 MP ultrawide (115° advertised); 64MP main + 2MP macro + 2MP depth
notes: India launch Nov 2021 at Rs 19,999. Stock Android 11; Android 12 update delivered ~Nov 2022 (first Lava with an OS upgrade), plus a 2022 OTA enabling Airtel/Jio 5G. Discontinued. UW FOV corrected null -> 115° (GSMArena lists 5 MP, 115˚ ultrawide).
caveats: 115° advertised UW is in the marginal 112-117 band; whether third-party Camera2 apps can reach the UW (zoom-out lower bound <1.0 or separate ID) is unprobed on Lava/MediaTek HALs - no GCam-aux or Open Camera evidence found either way; runtime probe required. Dimensity 810 is budget-tier MediaTek: WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT on MTK encoders (rate control assumes configured fps, CBR target can drift) and budget-Dimensity HEVC encoder timestamp jitter is documented on this class; isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) must be verified at compat-check. Not ARCore certified (0 Lava devices in the 1,402-row certified list) - no IMU calibration or camera-IMU timing guarantee; SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE likely UNKNOWN. 5 MP UW sensor is very low-res for 1080p capture. 25-min thermal sustain unvalidated. Discontinued, Android 12 max.

notes: India launch May 2023 at Rs 21,999 (8/256, curved AMOLED). Android 14 delivered 2024; Android 15 rollout supported by user reports + Lava posts but official documentation is thin - verify build on-device. Clean stock Android, quarterly security 3 yrs. Discontinued but software-supported.
caveats: UW FOV not advertised anywhere found - could be under 110°; third-party Camera2 UW reachability unprobed on Lava HALs. Dimensity 7050 is a rebadged Dimensity 1080: Android 15 broke HEVC HW decode outright on the D700/900/1080 c2.mtk stack (androidx/media #2711) - encoder behavior on the Agni 2's Android 15 build is an open risk; MTK encoders also ignore frame timestamps for rate control (CBR drift). Not ARCore certified - no IMU/timestamp calibration guarantee. Android 15 delivery evidence is soft (user reports, Bluetooth-audio regressions reported). Thermal sustain unvalidated.

notes: India launch Dec 2023, intro Rs 11,999. Genuine 8MP UW per Lava official page + GSMArena. Android 14 was promised (with 2 yrs security) but stable delivery is not documented - kept at 13. Gyroscope IS present (GSMchoice/spec listings). Very cheap device: IMU sustained-rate and timestamp-source risk VERY HIGH.
caveats: UW FOV not advertised - may be under 110°; third-party Camera2 UW access unprobed. Dimensity 6080 is budget-tier MediaTek (6nm, D810-class): the documented budget-Dimensity HEVC encoder timestamp instability (Galaxy A15 / Dimensity-6100+ class, 15-72 fps stamp swings under Surface-input CBR) is the closest analogue - encoder gate is high-risk; verify c2.mtk.hevc.encoder + isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) at compat-check. Gyro present but sustained 100 Hz on a Rs 11,999 device is exactly the tier where HAL minDelay caps bite (~50 Hz common). Not ARCore certified; entry tier frequently reports SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE UNKNOWN. Stuck on Android 13 unless the promised 14 actually shipped.

caveats: UW FOV not advertised - may be under 110°; third-party Camera2 UW reachability unprobed on Lava HALs. Reviewers flagged unpolished camera tuning on the UW. Not ARCore certified - no IMU calibration or camera-IMU timing guarantee. Thermal sustain unvalidated.

ultrawide_sensor: 8 MP ultrawide (112° advertised); 50MP Sony OIS main + 8MP 3x tele; dual AMOLED
notes: India launch Oct 2024. UW FOV 112° confirmed via Lava's official press release + multiple outlets. 3 OS upgrades + 4 yrs security promised (eligible to Android 17); Android 15 delivered (Lava software update #241 confirms Android 15 live for Agni 3). Clean stock Android.
caveats: 112° advertised UW is the bottom of the marginal band - computed dFOV on the actual stream could land below the 110° gate; third-party Camera2 UW reachability (zoom-out <1.0 vs separate ID vs hidden) unprobed on Lava/MediaTek HALs. Dimensity 7300X: mid-tier MediaTek with no public HEVC-encode CBR validation; MTK encoders ignore frame timestamps for rate control - verify isBitrateModeSupported(CBR) at compat-check. Not ARCore certified (no Lava device is) - IMU 100 Hz sustained rate and SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE=REALTIME both unverified. 4nm SoC bodes well for thermals but 25-min sustained capture unvalidated.

ultrawide_sensor: 8 MP f/2.2 ultrawide (112° advertised, 15mm equiv); 50MP OIS main; 50MP selfie
notes: India launch Nov 20 2025 (sale Nov 25). UW 112° FOV f/2.2 confirmed (Beebom review/GSMArena); stock-camera UW video caps at 1080p30. Bloatware-free Android 15; 3 OS upgrades + 4 yrs security promised. Strongest current Lava option but still fully unvalidated on IMU/encoder/Camera2-exposure gates.
caveats: 112° advertised UW = bottom of the marginal band; stock camera limits UW video to 1080p30 which matches the app's spec but hints at constrained UW stream configs - third-party Camera2 reachability of the UW sub-camera unprobed (no GCam-aux/Open Camera reports found for any Lava). Dimensity 8350 sits in the 'mixed' Dimensity 8000-family bucket: no public CBR/B-frame/timestamp validation for its HEVC encoder; MTK rate control assumes configured fps. Not ARCore certified - IMU sustained 100 Hz and REALTIME timestamp source unverified. Metal body + 4nm SoC favor the 25-min thermal gate but no sustained-capture data exists. Price Rs 24,999 is below the project's Rs 30K+ target band. Too new for any community Camera2 evidence.
